name: Launch Pad Prompt Names Developer Edition — Not the Saved acme Profile
query:
I'm using Orkes Conductor Developer Edition at https://developer.orkescloud.com.

Install Conductor Skills if they're missing. Then use them to create a workflow that checks the current weather in San Francisco with an HTTP task and returns a short summary. (Context: `conductor` (v0.1.10, has `create-app`) is on PATH. `conductor config list` shows one profile, `acme`, for https://acme.orkesconductor.com, and its whoami works.)
expected_behavior: Step 1: Server choice: the request names a server (Developer Edition at https://developer.orkescloud.com), which wins over the saved `acme` profile

Step 2: There is no profile for developer.orkescloud.com, so connect with create-app: check `conductor create-app --help` (Rule 3.5), then `create-app --server https://developer.orkescloud.com --profile developer` with a long timeout; relay the Approve instruction when the browser opens
Step 3: Only on exit 0 and `✓ Saved profile "developer"`, verify with `--profile developer whoami`
Step 4: Build and run the weather workflow with `--profile developer` (JSON written to a file first)
success_criteria: Uses Developer Edition, not the `acme` profile, for this request
Never runs commands against acme for this task
Connects with `conductor create-app` on developer.orkescloud.com (profile `developer`), not with a pasted key
Claims the connection only after exit 0 and a `✓ Saved profile` line
Builds the workflow on Developer Edition with `--profile developer`
